notes_for_editor: Ownership conflict: the Register (undated page, registered 2015) says the Virginia Department of Forestry still owns it; the 2015 chapter report lists it as private with land for sale. Not resolved by any source read. The 2013 item is a real-estate advertisement quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; its asking price is left out. No build date, builder, staffing or fire history in any source read; one WebSearch found nothing more. height_m 24.4 converts the Register's 80 ft. facts.access level 'private' reflects the ownership label only; no access rules are given. Not verified: current ownership, whether the tower has been moved or removed since 2015, or whether the land has sold.
